name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Family Reunification

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse, minor child, or dependent parent of a Latvian citizen or of a foreign resident of Latvia.
Proof of stable income of approximately EUR 740/month per adult and EUR 222/month per child.

evidence_required.document: Marriage or birth certificate proving family tie
Proof of income (~EUR 740/month per adult, EUR 222/month per child)

outcome.duration_length: first application: 1 year; renewal: 4 years; third application leads to permanent status

sources.title: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP), official English page -- family reunification permit duration structure: 1 year on first application, 4 years on the second, permanent status upon the third
Immigrant Invest (relocation consultancy) -- family reunification: qualifying relationships and income thresholds (EUR 740/month per adult, EUR 222/month per child)
